content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The Agency's conclusion of no discrimination is linked to cited gaps (no corroboration, vague allegations, missing affidavit), but the record does not show what evidence supported the finding that management 'took whatever action it could,' so the path from evidence to that conclusion is not fully reconstructable."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Many characterizations are attributed to ROI pages (S1 at 116, Lead Manager at 130, Complainant at 8-11), but the Agency's findings, such as that Complainant and C1 lived together, are stated without any identified source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Some dates are given (March 2017 start, October 2018 PS-13, August 7, 2018 interview, November 16, 2018 filing, September 2019 AJ orders), but the October 2018 PS-13 post-dates the 'since March 2017' harassment claim, and the timing of management's separation of the parties and of the rumors is not documented."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who at the Agency reviewed the matter or made the final decision, what anti-harassment policy steps or criteria were applied, or whether the S1 and Lead Manager statements were weighed against Complainant's claims before the decision was finalized."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the Complainant's affidavit is missing, the Lead Manager's account conflicts with the Complainant's on whether the rumors were reported, and the reviewer, criteria, and sourcing for key findings are not documented, an independent reviewer could not assess whether the conclusion is supported without outside context."}}}
